summary: Iteration 17 — v2.17 web-frontend validation for BoothIQ CRM. All 4 requested features verified end-to-end via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. (1) Users & Roles bulk operations: created 2 throwaway account_manager users, verified bulk-bar appears on row selection, bulk-deactivate flipped both to Inactive (toast '2 user(s) deactivated'), bulk-activate flipped back to Active (toast '2 user(s) activated'), bulk-delete removed both rows (toast 'Deleted 2'), and bulk-select-all checked 12/12 remaining rows. (2) Call Lists as account_manager: cl-my-queue built a 143-lead queue (toast 'Queue built · 143 leads (sorted by 340B/RPM tier)') and auto-started calling with L-00001 Acme Cardiology showing 340B GREEN first; New Call List modal exposed cl-mine checkbox and cl-tier dropdown containing ['Any','GREEN','YELLOW','BLUE','RED']; a TESTQ_* list with mine+Any was created (143 leads) and Start Calling opened queue-card with a GREEN-tier first lead. (3) Import wizard: uploaded /tmp/import_sample.csv, reached Map Columns step; all 7 required testIDs present (import-source, import-add-source, import-year, import-rule, import-distribute, import-preset, import-save-preset); 'Medicare Scrape' preset already in dropdown; saved a new preset TestPreset_<ts> via window.prompt, dropdown updated, mutating year/rule/distribute then selecting the new preset re-applied year=2026, rule=refresh, distribute=equal (toast 'Loaded preset ...'). (4) Bulk Enrich on Leads: selected exactly 1 lead-row checkbox, clicked bulk-enrich-btn, POST /api/crm/enrichment/bulk → 200 with response {total:1, done:1, status:'completed', counts:{enriched:0, no_match:1}} and dual toast 'Enriching 1 lead(s) in the background…' + 'Enrichment done — 0 enriched, 1 no match'. No red screens, no console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.js:146 — lead-row selection checkbox has no data-testid (only the row has lead-row-<id>). Tests must reach into the row's first td to find the input[type=checkbox]. Consider adding data-testid=`lead-select-${l.id}` for parity with Users.js user-select-<id>.

ImportWizard.js:41 savePreset — uses window.prompt() for the preset name. Works but breaks headless environments without a dialog handler; consider a controlled Modal + input for better UX and testability.
Users.js:33-34 — deactivate/delete guarded by window.confirm(); fine but not testable without page.on('dialog'). Non-blocking.

CallLists.js:96 — 'cl-my-queue' one-tap builds+starts the queue AND auto-navigates to /crm/call-lists/<id>/queue. The 143 tier-sorted leads returned by /api/crm/call-lists/mine-queue match the expected AM assignment. GREEN-first ordering confirmed by first card (L-00001, 340B GREEN).

ImportWizard.js:30-39 applyPreset — nice: resets year/rule/distribute defaults if the saved preset omits them, so mixed old/new presets won't leave stale state. But note: `distribute || 'route'` and `rule || 'safe'` overwrite user-set values even if the preset intentionally didn't include them — currently OK since save always writes both.

routes_bulk.py bulk-enrich returned the completed job synchronously (total:1, done:1, status:'completed') within ~1s for a single lead. This matches PDL throttle for tiny jobs; toast copy 'Enriching 1 lead(s) in the background…' is emitted client-side before the request resolves, then a completion toast follows — good UX pattern.
